title: Keep Living Flame's image through quality changes
acceptance: A forced quality-tier change at pixel ratio 1 and 2 never clears the accumulated image (R3: no frame below 80% of the previous frame's centre brightness at a step).
A real resize carries the old image into the new buffer before the next presented frame.

evidence.note: Investigation of production 97ca014f: probe measurements, code references and the last 14 days of history.

activity.summary: Seeded from Phase A of the Consolidated Reader proposal; needs no owner decision.

summary: The reproduced stutter: Living Flame clears its image on every quality-tier change (field.js:224-247, gl-flame.js:358-391), so one near-black frame reaches the screen.
